name: ... and that note you found
label: Quest
description: In Westfall, a scorched note survives beside a dying campfire. Its brief message points toward a place called the twin land.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Westfall, a scorched note survives beside a dying campfire. Its brief message points toward a place called the twin land.

Across Westfall's abandoned fields and wind-scoured plains, travelers find camps left by vagrants, outlaws, and desperate wanderers. This small camp may have been left in haste or secrecy; its provisions lie abandoned, and embers still glow. A scorched slip of parchment rests among the scattered debris.

The blistered note bears two short sentences: “Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place.” The words point away from Westfall, but give no clear direction. What place shares a name, geography, or fate with this land?

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.
Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.
"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."

clips.title: Completion
paras: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.
